behaviour.text:
Feed decisions (product owner, 2026-11-16/17 — PRD §6.5)

• The feed is Home for signed-in people. Tabs: Nearby (Bangalore, newest) · Following · Top this week.
• Top this week = likes + 3 × comments over 7 days. Display order only: never points, rank or prizes.
• Every verified deed is published automatically. The doer or the reporter can hide it any time — visibility only; it still counts. Hiding also turns its share link off.
• Withdrawn, rejected, flagged or removed deeds leave the feed. Self-logs and unverified deeds never appear.
• Cards show an area name only — never GPS, phone numbers or private details.
• Comments: any member; 300 characters; rate-limited; a kind-words filter. Authors delete their own; the doer and reporter can delete any comment on their deed. ("You're commenting very fast — try again in a minute" for the rate limit.)
• Follows: open, one-way. You can remove followers.
• Saves are private: a Saved list on your profile, no counts.
• Shared links: one deed, visible without login; liking, commenting, following and browsing need sign-up.
• Notifications come in M6.

Sample viewer: Priya Sharma. Press Play: like, save, share, follow, open Ahmed's deed (Priya reported it) → comment, delete a comment, hide from feed.
